summary: 13 errors, 35 minor in 27 of 58 units. Main errors: pinvamānam agreement (u2), Hindi additions (u4, u10), caskanda mis-split (u5), īman misread as eman (u17, u53), ruco = rucaḥ (u22), abhikalpamānāḥ/ṛtū agreement (u25), hi handling in u36. No regrouping needed; u24 and u58 keep edition grouping.
